current_answer: 18 listed ambassador routes have issuer-linked ways to apply and no published passed deadline. Stellar Ambassadors uses country-focused chapters. Official docs point people to an intake form; Rise In’s current partner route covers five named countries and says selection is ongoing, proof of work is required and a trial applies. It does not state a cash award. Midnight Nightforce has an official Apply Now route but is volunteer-based and does not promise immediate financial rewards. Thrilld invites global Web3 professionals for partnership, content and regional work, while leaving KPI compensation terms unpublished. Injective remains an impact-based INJ route with no individual amount, workload or selection terms. Arc is contribution-based rather than a general application, BNB’s old Martians form remains unavailable, Pendulum is Discord enrollment, Wager Predict is unconfirmed, Bitget’s trading-builder campaign ends 30 Sep, MetaMask is not confirmed, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.

catalogue_card.question: Three application routes, three very different bargains.
catalogue_card.text: Stellar’s Rise In route asks for proof of work and a trial, Midnight calls its ambassador route volunteer work, and Thrilld leaves KPI compensation terms unpublished. Each has an issuer or issuer-partner route; none is a fixed pay offer.

summary: Stellar’s official Ambassador docs describe country-focused chapters and an intake route. Rise In’s current partner page presents routes in Türkiye, India, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines; it says selection is ongoing, proof of work is required and a trial applies. The pages name potential pathways and rewards but no individual cash amount or allocation rule.
Midnight Nightforce visibly links an official Apply Now route, but calls the program a volunteer foundation and says immediate financial rewards are not its purpose.

Thrilld’s official page invites global Web3 professionals to apply for outreach, partnership, content and event work. It says ambassadors decide their monthly time and compensation is tied to KPI-tracked achievements, but no KPI or amount is published.
Hosted forms were not inspected successfully in this check. An issuer or issuer-partner link does not prove live submission acceptance, selection or payment.
uncertainty: A visible issuer or issuer-partner application route does not prove that a hosted form accepts submissions, that a person will be selected, or that payment will occur.
Stellar does not publish an individual cash award, funding-pathway eligibility, prize allocation, hours or trial details.
Midnight does not publish Nightforce hours, review time, acceptance criteria or a pay, token or airdrop promise.
Thrilld does not publish its KPI, compensation amount, unit, timing, selection criteria or review time.
Most listed routes still lack decision-ready cash terms, hours, full selection rules or independent participant reports.
